formal_statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size ≤ 8 ∧ (∀ x : Fin 6 → Bool, (C.eval (List.ofFn x) = true ↔ ∃ u v : Fin 6, (u.val, v.val) ∈ ([(0, 1), (1, 2), (0, 2), (3, 4), (4, 5), (3, 5), (0, 3), (1, 4), (2, 5)] : List (ℕ × ℕ)) ∧ x u = true ∧ x v = true))
plain_statement: Is there a circuit of AND and OR gates only, each reading at most two wires, with at most 8 gates, true on 6 inputs exactly when both ends of some edge are true? The graph is the triangular prism: triangles 0 1 2 and 3 4 5 and the edges 03, 14, 25; 9 edges, vertex cover number 4 (by script), 4-cycles but no two non-adjacent vertices with the same neighbours. The count n - 1 + tau for such graphs is 9. Wanted either way: a gate list, verified by evaluating it on all 64 inputs, or that none exists. No witness is known. Conjecture either way.
title: Search: a circuit of AND and OR gates with at most 8 gates for the edge function of the triangular prism
